card.name: Dosage-form words in administration instructions
card.fires_on: Words in dosing instructions just before or inside a dosage-form word such as tablet, capsule, vials or sodium salt names. It also fires on pieces of drug names in those passages.

modes.label: Before a dosage form
modes.description: The marked word comes right before tablet or capsule in a dose instruction.

modes.label: Inside split dosage-form words
modes.description: The marked piece is part of a word being split, like capsule or vials, in preparation or dosing text.
modes.example: one 100 mg ritonavir tablet<</c>>apsule, taken twice daily with food

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: The marked piece sits inside a brand or generic drug name in a dosing or warning line.
modes.example: Aspirin, Caffeine , and Codeine<< Ph>>osphate Capsules, USP is contr

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like dosage and preparation and of Chinese dosage-form characters, while raising some Chinese words for tablet and drop.
card.plain: It marks spots in dosing directions where a tablet, capsule or vial is about to be named.
